response.query: How will we document lesion label provenance, adjudication protocol, and model label-noise; what drift-detection and mitigation methods will be pre-specified?
response.answer: Lesion label provenance, adjudication protocol, and model label-noise will be documented in a dedicated report. Drift-detection will use statistical methods, and mitigation will involve retraining models periodically.
